name: Trouble at Home
source:
Since transferring schools to get distance from your twin sister and all the issues surrounding her, you've managed to turn life into something better: easy job, loyal friends, star baseball player, and a long-term relationship.
But after stopping one evening to help a stranger in need, a series of events were triggered that toppled everything important to you.
With graduation around the corner and disasters mounting, it's not so easy to run away from your problems this time. Will you be able to salvage everything you lost, and perhaps finally mend the one relationship you never thought possible?​
